School taught you how to get a job. Not how to create one.
Sit down. Raise your hand. Wait for the bell.
Follow instructions, and you get a gold star.
Make a mistake? You lose marks.
That's perfect training for an employee.
But a C E O needs the opposite.
They fail fast, and learn from it.
They ask why, instead of waiting for instructions.
And nobody hands them a timetable.
School isn't useless. It just isn't the whole picture.
So teach yourself what school never did.
Learn money. Learn to sell. Learn to build.
